Name: Mouse Ears to Temmie Ears (Content Patcher)
Author: m2pt5
Description:
Taking inspiration from the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2096]Hat Mouse to Tem Shop[/url]" mod, this replaces the Mouse Ears hat (unlocked by reaching a 10 heart friendship level with someone) with the ears of [url=http://undertale.wikia.com/wiki/Temmie]Temmie[/url], all four of them.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
